fit_reason: Although listed as a private seller, the photos show a brand-new boat on a dealer showroom floor (Rapid Marine signage, other new inventory around it), so this is dealer stock rather than a private owner's boat.
findings: Hull paint and graphics are glossy and clean on both sides
Mercury outboard cowling is clean and shiny
Carpet, seats and storage compartments look new and spotless
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Crestliner 1850 Fish Hawk. It already looks showroom clean, with glossy hull paint and spotless carpet and seats. If you ever want a detail or polish to keep it looking that way, we come to you and would be happy to give you a quote.
